"""
Canonical lifecycle contracts, states, invariants, and transition guards
for all Slice-1 document workflow entities.

This module is the single source of truth for:
- Lifecycle state enumerations per entity
- Allowed and forbidden transition maps
- Immutability invariants for audit rows
- Slice-1 reservation rules (Document.state='exported' reserved but
  transition forbidden; all other canonical transitions allowed)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import enum
from typing import Dict, FrozenSet


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Document lifecycle
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class DocumentState(str, enum.Enum):
    """
    Canonical document lifecycle states.

    Slice-1 reservation rule:
        The ``exported`` state is present in the schema for forward
        compatibility but **no Slice-1 code may transition a document
        into or out of ``exported``**.  All other transitions listed in
        ``DOCUMENT_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS`` are permitted.
    """
    UPLOADED = "uploaded"
    PROCESSING = "processing"
    VALIDATION_READY = "validation_ready"
    EXCEPTION = "exception"
    VALIDATED = "validated"
    EXPORTED = "exported"


# Allowed transitions: source_state -> frozenset of allowed target states
DOCUMENT_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS: Dict[DocumentState, FrozenSet[DocumentState]] = {
    DocumentState.UPLOADED: frozenset({DocumentState.PROCESSING}),
    DocumentState.PROCESSING: frozenset({
        DocumentState.VALIDATION_READY,
        DocumentState.EXCEPTION,
    }),
    DocumentState.VALIDATION_READY: frozenset({DocumentState.VALIDATED}),
    DocumentState.EXCEPTION: frozenset(),
    DocumentState.VALIDATED: frozenset(),
    DocumentState.EXPORTED: frozenset(),
}

# Slice-1 reserved state — no transition into or out of exported
DOCUMENT_SLICE1_RESERVED_STATES: FrozenSet[DocumentState] = frozenset({
    DocumentState.EXPORTED,
})


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ExtractedField lifecycle
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class ExtractedFieldStatus(str, enum.Enum):
    PROPOSED = "proposed"
    CORRECTED = "corrected"
    ACCEPTED = "accepted"
    REJECTED = "rejected"


EXTRACTED_FIELD_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS: Dict[
    ExtractedFieldStatus, FrozenSet[ExtractedFieldStatus]
] = {
    ExtractedFieldStatus.PROPOSED: frozenset({
        ExtractedFieldStatus.CORRECTED,
        ExtractedFieldStatus.ACCEPTED,
        ExtractedFieldStatus.REJECTED,
    }),
    ExtractedFieldStatus.CORRECTED: frozenset({
        ExtractedFieldStatus.ACCEPTED,
    }),
    ExtractedFieldStatus.ACCEPTED: frozenset(),
    ExtractedFieldStatus.REJECTED: frozenset(),
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Task lifecycle
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class TaskStatus(str, enum.Enum):
    OPEN = "open"
    IN_PROGRESS = "in_progress"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    EXCEPTION = "exception"


TASK_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS: Dict[TaskStatus, FrozenSet[TaskStatus]] = {
    TaskStatus.OPEN: frozenset({
        TaskStatus.IN_PROGRESS,
        TaskStatus.EXCEPTION,
    }),
    TaskStatus.IN_PROGRESS: frozenset({
        TaskStatus.COMPLETED,
        TaskStatus.EXCEPTION,
    }),
    TaskStatus.COMPLETED: frozenset(),
    TaskStatus.EXCEPTION: frozenset(),
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TaskType — fixed to validation in Slice-1
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class TaskType(str, enum.Enum):
    VALIDATION = "validation"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Notification lifecycle
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class NotificationStatus(str, enum.Enum):
    PENDING = "pending"
    SENT = "sent"
    FAILED = "failed"
    READ = "read"


NOTIFICATION_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS: Dict[
    NotificationStatus, FrozenSet[NotificationStatus]
] = {
    NotificationStatus.PENDING: frozenset({
        NotificationStatus.SENT,
        NotificationStatus.FAILED,
    }),
    NotificationStatus.SENT: frozenset({NotificationStatus.READ}),
    NotificationStatus.FAILED: frozenset(),
    NotificationStatus.READ: frozenset(),
}

# NotificationChannel and NotificationType
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class NotificationChannel(str, enum.Enum):
    DASHBOARD = "dashboard"
    EMAIL = "email"


class NotificationType(str, enum.Enum):
    VALIDATION_READY = "validation_ready"
    EXCEPTION = "exception"
    EXPORT_READY = "export_ready"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ExportJob lifecycle
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class ExportJobStatus(str, enum.Enum):
    REQUESTED = "requested"
    RUNNING = "running"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    FAILED = "failed"


EXPORT_JOB_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS: Dict[
    ExportJobStatus, FrozenSet[ExportJobStatus]
] = {
    ExportJobStatus.REQUESTED: frozenset({ExportJobStatus.RUNNING}),
    ExportJobStatus.RUNNING: frozenset({
        ExportJobStatus.COMPLETED,
        ExportJobStatus.FAILED,
    }),
    ExportJobStatus.COMPLETED: frozenset(),
    ExportJobStatus.FAILED: frozenset(),
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class AIQueryStatus(str, enum.Enum):
    REQUESTED = "requested"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    DENIED = "denied"
    FAILED = "failed"


AI_QUERY_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS: Dict[
    AIQueryStatus, FrozenSet[AIQueryStatus]
] = {
    AIQueryStatus.REQUESTED: frozenset({
        AIQueryStatus.COMPLETED,
        AIQueryStatus.DENIED,
        AIQueryStatus.FAILED,
    }),
    AIQueryStatus.COMPLETED: frozenset(),
    AIQueryStatus.DENIED: frozenset(),
    AIQueryStatus.FAILED: frozenset(),
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# AuditEvent type enum
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class AuditEventType(str, enum.Enum):
    UPLOAD = "upload"
    PARSE = "parse"
    OCR = "ocr"
    CLASSIFY = "classify"
    CORRECT = "correct"
    VALIDATE = "validate"
    NOTIFY = "notify"
    SEARCH = "search"
    EXPORT = "export"
    AI_QUERY = "ai_query"
    EXCEPTION = "exception"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Document format enum
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class DocumentFormat(str, enum.Enum):
    PDF = "pdf"
    DOCX = "docx"
    XLSX = "xlsx"
    PPTX = "pptx"
    JPG = "jpg"
    PNG = "png"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Transition guard helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Slice1TransitionForbidden(Exception):
    """Raised when a Slice-1 reserved state transition is attempted."""


class ForbiddenTransitionError(Exception):
    """Raised when a lifecycle transition is not in the allowed-transition map."""

    def __init__(self, entity: str, source: str, target: str) -> None:
        self.entity = entity
        self.source = source
        self.target = target
        super().__init__(
            f"Forbidden transition for {entity}: {source} -> {target}"
        )


def validate_transition(
    entity_name: str,
    allowed_map: Dict,
    source: enum.Enum,
    target: enum.Enum,
) -> None:
    """
    Validate a lifecycle transition against the allowed-transition map.

    Raises ``ForbiddenTransitionError`` if the transition is not explicitly
    allowed.
    """
    allowed_targets = allowed_map.get(source, frozenset())
    if target not in allowed_targets:
        raise ForbiddenTransitionError(entity_name, source.value, target.value)


def validate_document_transition(
    source: DocumentState,
    target: DocumentState,
) -> None:
    """
    Validate a document state transition.

    Raises ``Slice1TransitionForbidden`` if either state is reserved in
    Slice-1.  Raises ``ForbiddenTransitionError`` if the transition is
    not in the allowed map.
    """
    if source in DOCUMENT_SLICE1_RESERVED_STATES or target in DOCUMENT_SLICE1_RESERVED_STATES:
        raise Slice1TransitionForbidden(
            f"Document state '{source.value}' or '{target.value}' is reserved "
            f"in Slice-1 and transitions are forbidden."
        )
    validate_transition("Document", DOCUMENT_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS, source, target)


def validate_extracted_field_transition(
    source: ExtractedFieldStatus,
    target: ExtractedFieldStatus,
) -> None:
    validate_transition(
        "ExtractedField",
        EXTRACTED_FIELD_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS,
        source,
        target,
    )


def validate_task_transition(
    source: TaskStatus,
    target: TaskStatus,
) -> None:
    validate_transition("Task", TASK_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS, source, target)


def validate_notification_transition(
    source: NotificationStatus,
    target: NotificationStatus,
) -> None:
    validate_transition(
        "Notification",
        NOTIFICATION_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS,
        source,
        target,
    )


def validate_export_job_transition(
    source: ExportJobStatus,
    target: ExportJobStatus,
) -> None:
    validate_transition(
        "ExportJob",
        EXPORT_JOB_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS,
        source,
        target,
    )


def validate_ai_query_transition(
    source: AIQueryStatus,
    target: AIQueryStatus,
) -> None:
    validate_transition(
        "AIQuery",
        AI_QUERY_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS,
        source,
        target,
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Immutability invariants for AuditEvent
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

AUDIT_EVENT_IMMUTABLE_FIELDS: FrozenSet[str] = frozenset({
    "id",
    "document_id",
    "actor_id",
    "event_type",
    "before_value",
    "after_value",
    "reason",
    "created_at",
})


def assert_audit_immutability(field_name: str) -> None:
    """
    Raise ``ValueError`` if an attempt is made to mutate an immutable
    audit field.
    """
    if field_name in AUDIT_EVENT_IMMUTABLE_FIELDS:
        raise ValueError(
            f"AuditEvent.{field_name} is immutable and cannot be modified."
        )

"""
SQLAlchemy ORM models for all Slice-1 canonical entities.

Entities:
    User, Document, ExtractedField, Task, AuditEvent,
    Notification, ExportJob, AIQuery

Design notes:
    - PostgreSQL 16 target with full-text search via ``tsvector``.
    - ``AuditEvent`` rows are append-only; no UPDATE/DELETE at app level.
    - ``Document.state = exported`` is reserved in Slice-1; transitions
      into or out of ``exported`` are forbidden.
    - All timestamps are timezone-aware (``TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE``).
    - UUIDs are used as primary keys for all entities.
    - Field names and enum values match the canonical data contracts in
      TARGET_CONTRACT.json and plan.json.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from sqlalchemy import (
    Boolean,
    CheckConstraint,
    Column,
    DateTime,
    Enum,
    ForeignKey,
    Index,
    Integer,
    Numeric,
    String,
    Text,
    UniqueConstraint,
    text,
)
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import JSONB, TSVECTOR, UUID
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, relationship

from .contracts import (
    AIQueryStatus,
    AuditEventType,
    DocumentFormat,
    DocumentState,
    ExportJobStatus,
    ExtractedFieldStatus,
    NotificationChannel,
    NotificationStatus,
    NotificationType,
    TaskStatus,
    TaskType,
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Base
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


def _utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# User
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    username = Column(String(256), nullable=False, unique=True)
    display_name = Column(String(256), nullable=False)
    active = Column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=True)
    idp_group_refs = Column(JSONB, nullable=False, server_default=text("'[]'::jsonb"))
    created_at = Column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, default=_utcnow
    )
    updated_at = Column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, default=_utcnow, onupdate=_utcnow
    )

    # relationships
    uploaded_documents = relationship(
        "Document",
        back_populates="uploader",
        foreign_keys="Document.uploaded_by",
        lazy="select",
    )
    tasks = relationship("Task", back_populates="assignee", lazy="select")

    __table_args__ = (
        Index("ix_users_username", "username"),
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Document
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Document(Base):
    __tablename__ = "documents"

    id = Column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    original_filename = Column(String(512), nullable=False)
    media_type = Column(String(256), nullable=False)
    format = Column(
        Enum(DocumentFormat, name="document_format", create_constraint=True),
        nullable=False,
    )
    size_bytes = Column(Integer, nullable=False)
    storage_uri = Column(Text, nullable=False)
    extracted_text_uri = Column(Text, nullable=True)
    classification_label = Column(String(256), nullable=True)
    state = Column(
        Enum(DocumentState, name="document_state", create_constraint=True),
        nullable=False,
        default=DocumentState.UPLOADED,
    )
    uploaded_by = Column(
        UUID(as_uuid=True),
        ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="RESTRICT"),
        nullable=False,
    )
    uploaded_at = Column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, default=_utcnow
    )
    validated_by = Column(
        UUID(as_uuid=True),
        ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="RESTRICT"),
        nullable=True,
    )
    validated_at = Column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)
    metadata_ = Column("metadata", JSONB, nullable=False, server_default=text("'{}'::jsonb"))
    content_tsv = Column(TSVECTOR, nullable=True)
    created_at = Column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, default=_utcnow
    )
    updated_at = Column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, default=_utcnow, onupdate=_utcnow
    )

    # relationships
    uploader = relationship(
        "User",
        back_populates="uploaded_documents",
        foreign_keys=[uploaded_by],
        lazy="select",
    )
    extracted_fields = relationship(
        "ExtractedField", back_populates="document", lazy="select"
    )

    __table_args__ = (
        CheckConstraint("size_bytes >= 0 AND size_bytes <= 20971520", name="ck_documents_size_bytes"),
        Index("ix_documents_uploaded_by", "uploaded_by"),
        Index("ix_documents_state", "state"),
        Index("ix_documents_metadata", "metadata", postgresql_using="gin"),
        Index("ix_documents_content_tsv", "content_tsv", postgresql_using="gin"),
        Index("ix_documents_created_at", "created_at"),
        Index("ix_documents_classification_label", "classification_label"),
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ExtractedField
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class ExtractedField(Base):
    __tablename__ = "extracted_fields"

    id = Column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    document_id = Column(
        UUID(as_uuid=True),
        ForeignKey("documents.id", ondelete="CASCADE"),
        nullable=False,
    )
    field_name = Column(String(256), nullable=False)
    proposed_value = Column(Text, nullable=True)
    confidence_score = Column(
        Numeric(5, 4), nullable=False, default=0
    )
    corrected_value = Column(Text, nullable=True)
    provenance = Column(Text, nullable=True)
    status = Column(
        Enum(ExtractedFieldStatus, name="extracted_field_status", create_constraint=True),
        nullable=False,
        default=ExtractedFieldStatus.PROPOSED,
    )
    updated_by = Column(
        UUID(as_uuid=True),
        ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="SET NULL"),
        nullable=True,
    )
    created_at = Column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, default=_utcnow
    )
    updated_at = Column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, default=_utcnow, onupdate=_utcnow
    )

    # relationships
    document = relationship("Document", back_populates="extracted_fields", lazy="select")

    __table_args__ = (
        CheckConstraint(
            "confidence_score >= 0 AND confidence_score <= 1",
            name="ck_extracted_fields_confidence_score",
        ),
        UniqueConstraint("document_id", "field_name", name="uq_extracted_fields_document_field"),
        Index("ix_extracted_fields_document_id", "document_id"),
        Index("ix_extracted_fields_status", "status"),
        Index("ix_extracted_fields_field_name", "field_name"),
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Task
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Task(Base):
    __tablename__ = "tasks"

    id = Column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    document_id = Column(
        UUID(as_uuid=True),
        ForeignKey("documents.id", ondelete="CASCADE"),
        nullable=False,
    )
    task_type = Column(
        Enum(TaskType, name="task_type", create_constraint=True),
        nullable=False,
        default=TaskType.VALIDATION,
    )
    assignee_id = Column(
        UUID(as_uuid=True),
        ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="SET NULL"),
        nullable=True,
    )
    status = Column(
        Enum(TaskStatus, name="task_status", create_constraint=True),
        nullable=False,
        default=TaskStatus.OPEN,
    )
    due_at = Column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)
    created_at = Column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, default=_utcnow
    )
    updated_at = Column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, default=_utcnow, onupdate=_utcnow
    )

    # relationships

    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint("document_id", "task_type", name="uq_tasks_document_task_type"),
        Index("ix_tasks_assignee_id", "assignee_id"),
        Index("ix_tasks_status", "status"),
        Index("ix_tasks_document_id", "document_id"),
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# AuditEvent  (immutable – append-only)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class AuditEvent(Base):
    """
    Immutable audit log.  Rows must never be updated or deleted at the
    application level.  The ``actor_id`` and ``created_at`` fields are
    mandatory for every row.
    """
    __tablename__ = "audit_events"

    id = Column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    document_id = Column(
        UUID(as_uuid=True),
        ForeignKey("documents.id", ondelete="SET NULL"),
        nullable=True,
    )
    actor_id = Column(
        UUID(as_uuid=True),
        ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="RESTRICT"),
        nullable=True,
    )
    event_type = Column(
        Enum(AuditEventType, name="audit_event_type", create_constraint=True),
        nullable=False,
    )
    before_value = Column(JSONB, nullable=True)
    after_value = Column(JSONB, nullable=True)
    reason = Column(Text, nullable=True)
    created_at = Column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, default=_utcnow
    )

    # NOTE: no updated_at — rows are immutable

    __table_args__ = (
        Index("ix_audit_events_actor_id", "actor_id"),
        Index("ix_audit_events_document_id", "document_id"),
        Index("ix_audit_events_event_type", "event_type"),
        Index("ix_audit_events_created_at", "created_at"),
    )
